logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was assessed by partitioning 64Cu-ES or 64Cu-ATSM between n-octanol and phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, 0.1 mol/L, pH 7.4). Equal volumes of the compound and each solvent were mixed in test tubes, vortexed thoroughly, and centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 5 min at room temperature. The upper (n-octanol) and lower (PBS) phases were carefully separated and weighed. Radioactivity in each layer was measured using a gamma counter (PerkinElmer WIZARD2 2480, MA, USA). The Log P value was calculated as log[cpm/g(n-octanol)]/[cpm/g(PBS)] (n = 3).
